This bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant- Indal Kumar, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No.
56 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 5L/6 POCSO Act, registered at Police Station Dullahpur, District Ghazipur.

sentences.text: 5. The first information report of the present matter was lodged on 10.04.2023 under Sections 363 & 366 IPC by Smt. Seema Devi against the applicant alleging therein that her daughter aged about 17 years having date of birth as 01.01.2006 was made a false promise to marry by the applicant.

sentences.text: On 07.04.2020 at about 8:00 PM, applicant lured her daughter and enticed her away.

sentences._hearing_file: Indal Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant on false promise to marry used to establish physical relation with her and used to tell her to run away.
sentences._hearing_file: Indal Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: On 07.04.2023, the applicant took her away to Banaras where he established physical relation with her many times and since money had finished, they were returning back home for collecting money but they were apprehended and brought to the police station.
sentences._hearing_file: Indal Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is argued that in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim reiterated the same.
sentences._hearing_file: Indal Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: She further stated that the applicant has made a promise to marry her and then they made physical relation with each other.
sentences._hearing_file: Indal Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is argued that as such the victim was consenting party and no offence is made out.

sentences.text: It is lastly argued that the applicant is in jail since 11.04.2023, having no criminal history as stated in para-16 of the affidavit.

sentences.text:
7. Per contra, learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and argued that as per version of the FIR and the mark-sheet of the year 2022, the date of birth of the victim is 01.01.2006, as such,
at the time of incident, she was a minor.
sentences._hearing_file: Indal Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 20 July, 2023.json

sentences.text:

sentences.text:

9.
